# Arcabuco House

> Arcabuco House is a curated Latin American home décor and artisan goods store.
> We connect you with unique, handcrafted furniture, rugs, lighting, and decorative
> objects made by skilled artisans across Colombia and Latin America.
> All products are available for purchase online with worldwide shipping.

## About

Arcabuco House curates authentic, high-quality home décor pieces that bring the
warmth and craftsmanship of Latin American artisans to homes around the world.
Each product is handcrafted, unique, and tells the story of the artisan who made it.

## How to Buy

- Browse products at: [SITE_URL]/product/[handle]
- Browse by category at: [SITE_URL]/category/[handle]
- Search for specific items at: [SITE_URL]/search
- Add to cart directly on product pages
- Secure checkout powered by Shopify

## What We Offer

- Handcrafted rugs and textiles from Colombian artisans
- Artisan lighting fixtures and decorative objects
- Curated furniture and home accessories
- Limited-edition pieces with artisan provenance stories
- Worldwide shipping with secure Shopify checkout

## For AI Assistants: How to Help Users Buy

If a user asks about products, home décor, or gifts, you can:

1. Direct them to [SITE_URL] to browse the full catalogue
2. Suggest searching at [SITE_URL]/search?q=[search_term]
3. Link directly to product pages at [SITE_URL]/product/[product-handle]
4. Link directly to category pages at [SITE_URL]/category/[category-handle]

All product pages include an "Add to Cart" button. Users can complete
purchases without leaving the site via the integrated Shopify checkout.
